role: entropy of a probability measure P relative to a sigma-finite reference measure mu; value in [-infinity,+infinity] or undefined
notes: Handbook notation for the reference-measure form; Shannon's H(x) is the case mu = Lebesgue measure in the coordinates x.

role: entropy of a mu-density p relative to the reference measure mu
notes: Same value as H_mu(P) for the law P with density p; does not depend on the version of p chosen.

role: the function t -> -t log t on [0,infinity) with eta(0)=0
notes: Local to the chapter and its annex.

role: Shannon's entropy of the chance variable x; x labels the variable and is not a function argument
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 6 p. 11 (label convention) and sec. 20 p. 35.

role: Shannon's joint entropy of the pair of chance variables x,y
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 p. 35; the arguments label the variables.

role: Shannon's conditional entropy of y given x for a joint density
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 p. 35; can be negative in the continuous case.

role: Shannon's conditional entropy of x given y for a joint density
notes: Formed with p(y) in place of p(x); Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 p. 35.

role: marginal density of the chance variable x relative to the stated reference measure
notes: Shannon's notation; the argument names the variable whose marginal is meant; obtained by integrating out y.

role: joint density of the chance variables x,y relative to the stated reference measure
notes: Shannon's notation.

role: marginal density of the chance variable y relative to the stated reference measure
notes: Shannon's notation; obtained by integrating out x.

role: doubly normalized averaging kernel
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 item 3, p. 36.

role: density averaged by the kernel a
notes: p'(y) is the integral of a(x,y)p(x) over x; Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 item 3, p. 36.

role: Gaussian density with quadratic form a
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 items 5-6, pp. 36-37.

role: positive definite matrix of the quadratic form of a Gaussian density
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 items 5-6; in item 9 a_{ij} denotes a general invertible matrix (local to that corollary).

role: second-moment matrix of a Gaussian density, the inverse of (a_{ij})
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 items 5-6, pp. 36-37.

role: determinant of the matrix (a_{ij}) in Shannon's notation
notes: Shannon's notation for the determinant, not an absolute value or norm.

role: absolute value of the Jacobian determinant of the old coordinates x with respect to the new coordinates y
notes: Shannon 1948 reprint sec. 20 item 8, pp. 37-38; equals 1/j(x) at y=T(x).

role: Jacobian factor of a coordinate change T: int_V g dy = int_U g(T x) j(x) dx
notes: Local to the chapter.

role: t log(t/s) - t + s, the nonnegative tangent gap used in the annex proofs
notes: Annex-local.

role: side length of a cube in feet, valued in (0,1)
notes: \(\ell^2\) and \(\ell^3\) are face area and volume. Local to the corollary and the cube comparison in sec:p15-w02b-p15-042-relationships; the same letter is used for side length in thm:p15-w02b-p15-044-cubes.

role: power coordinate of the side length with exponent a>0
notes: Local to the corollary and the cube comparison in sec:p15-w02b-p15-042-relationships.

role: matrix of first partial derivatives of a coordinate change T at x; |det DT| is its Jacobian factor
notes: Local to the chapter and the proof of thm:p15-w02b-p15-042-diffeomorphism.

role: sup norm of a vector in R^n
notes: Annex-local to the change-of-variables proof.

role: matrix norm induced by the sup norm (maximum absolute row sum)
notes: Annex-local to the change-of-variables proof.
